easy.tailscaleBody: Private network; sign in on both devices.
easy.lanBody: No account needed; use a trusted home network.
easy.computerDetails: Open PowerShell from Start on Windows, or Terminal on Linux/macOS. Paste the command and press Enter. Wait for the QR code. Keep the pairing link private.
easy.tailscaleDetails: Use the same Tailscale account on both devices. The computer must be awake. If another VPN is active, check that Tailscale can connect.
easy.scanDetails: Scan the pairing QR, not the APK QR. Confirm the computer name. If scanning fails, use the six-digit code within 10 minutes. A 401 means credentials were rejected; create a fresh pairing link.
easy.choosePairing: Choose guided setup or pair with a computer that is already configured.

computer.title: Run one command on your computer
computer.body: Open PowerShell (Windows) or Terminal (macOS / Linux), paste the command, press Enter. It installs what is missing, starts the server and shows a QR code.
computer.tip: Tip: send this page to your computer, or type the address from the full guide there.

tailscale.title: Tailscale on this phone
tailscale.body: Install Tailscale and sign in with the same account you used on the computer. It makes a private link between the two. Same Wi-Fi and chose LAN mode? Skip this step.

scan.title: Scan the QR code
scan.body: A page with two QR codes opened on your computer. Tap the button below and point the camera at the second one. Then tap Connect.

launcher.offlineTitle: The server on your computer is off
launcher.hint: Start it from here (the computer must be on and online).
launcher.starting: Starting the server… up to 30 s

failed.unreachable: Cannot reach the computer. It may be asleep, offline, or its launcher is not running.
failed.unauthorized: The launcher refused the password. Pair with the computer again.
failed.timeout: The server did not come up. Check the computer.
failed.no-server: Nothing is set up on the computer yet. Run the installer there.

tailnet.waitBody: Sign in with the same Tailscale account as on your computer, then come back here.
tailnet.notConnected: Built-in Tailscale did not connect. Sign in and try again.

pairCode.title: Pair with a code
pairCode.intro: No camera needed. Run the setup command on your computer again: next to the QR code it shows 6 digits. The code works once, for 10 minutes.
pairCode.none: No computer found. Type its address below: the computer shows it next to the code.
pairCode.addressLabel: Computer address (only if it was not found)
pairCode.needTarget: Choose a computer or type its address.
pairCode.needCode: Type the 6 digits shown on the computer.
pairCode.burned: Too many wrong codes. Run the setup command on the computer again to get a new one.
pairCode.inactive: No code is waiting on this computer. Run the setup command there again: it shows a new code.
pairCode.unreachable: Could not reach the computer at {{address}}. Check that the phone and the computer are on the same network.

acp.title: Other agents
acp.entry: Other agents on the computer (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini…)
acp.intro: Chat with a coding agent that is installed on your computer, from the phone. Only agents found there are listed.
acp.none: No supported agent found on the computer. Install one (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Kimi Code…) and look again.
acp.outdated: The helper on the computer is too old for this. Run the setup command on the computer again, then look again.
acp.unreachable: Cannot reach the helper on the computer. Is it on and online?
acp.stopBody: This ends the agent on the computer, together with this chat.
acp.loginNeeded: {{agent}} needs you to sign in on the computer first ({{method}}). Sign in there, then open this chat again.
acp.gap: Part of the earlier chat is no longer stored.
acp.limit: The agent stopped at its limit.
acp.safeMode: The agent was in “{{from}}” mode, which runs tools without asking. Switched to “{{to}}” so it asks you first. Change it with the buttons above.
acp.notInstalled: Supported, not installed on the computer
acp.notInstalledHint: Install one of these on the computer, then tap “Look again”.

online-idle.body: The computer and the server answer. The agent is ready.

online-busy.title: Working
online-busy.body: The agent is working on your request.

reconnecting.title: Reconnecting…
reconnecting.body: The live connection dropped. The app keeps trying; messages arrive once it is back.

computer-unreachable.title: Computer offline
computer-unreachable.body: The phone can't reach your computer. Check that it is on, awake and online (home network or Tailscale).

server-stopped.title: Server stopped
server-stopped.body: The computer answers, but the agent server is not running. Start it from here.

auth-failed.title: Wrong password
auth-failed.body: The computer refused the password. Pair again or fix the password in the connection.

termuxSetup.title: Set up Termux
termuxSetup.intro: Termux lets the AI agent run commands on your phone. Follow the steps below; each one turns green when it is done.
termuxSetup.unavailable: Termux setup is not available in this app build.

install.title: Install Termux
install.body: Download Termux from its official GitHub release and install it. Android will ask you to confirm the installation.
install.loadFailed: Could not get the latest Termux version: {{error}}
install.needPermission: Android needs your permission to install apps from this app. Allow it on the next screen, then come back here.
install.checksum: The downloaded file is damaged (checksum mismatch). Try again.
install.signatureNote: If you installed Termux from F-Droid or Google Play before, remove it first: versions from different sources cannot be installed over each other.

open.title: Open Termux once
open.body: Open Termux and wait until it finishes its first-time setup (about a minute, internet needed). Then come back here.

allow.title: Allow commands from other apps
allow.body: Copy the line below, paste it in Termux and press Enter. It lets other apps run commands in Termux.

permission.title: Give AgentLink permission
permission.body: Android asks whether this app may run commands in Termux. Allow it.
permission.denied: The permission was not granted. If Android no longer asks, open this app's system settings, Permissions, and allow "Run commands in Termux environment".

test.title: Test
test.body: Runs a harmless command in Termux and shows the answer.
test.revisit: Go back to step {{n}} ({{name}}) and check it.
test.generic: Check that Termux was opened once (step 2), the line was pasted (step 3) and the permission is granted (step 4).

finish.title: Using it with the agent
finish.body: The agent can use Termux when Settings, Phone tools is on, the Termux switch is on, and the computer was set up with -PhoneTools.

localModel.title: Local models on your PC
localModel.unavailable: Models unavailable. Check that llama.cpp is running and the AgentLink launcher is up to date.
